description: CLK2 (carrier about 145 MHz, 3rd harmonic wanted) with the Si5351 screened and a screened pad fitted at the output, 30 cm of cable and the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB; NO filter

chain.name: screened pad on the CLK2 output
chain.notes: fully screened pad, nominal 8 dB; measured 8.9 dB at 435 MHz (8.9 to 9.5 dB over 425 to 445 MHz) on 2026-11-03 as the drop against the same cable and attenuator without it

chain.name: 30 cm cable
chain.notes: pad to the attenuator; the same cable as in the pad measurements; type not recorded; its loss is included in the measured pad figure

chain.name: attenuator
chain.notes: in front of the analyser; marked 10 dB, measured 25.8 dB at 435 MHz

notes: New topology (2026-11-03): the Si5351 board is screened and every output has a screened pad (about 8 dB nominal). No filter in line, so this is the raw output of the board and pad. The cable loss is included in the pad measurement, so pad_db is 34.7 dB.
